Faq.title: What clients ask before we start
Faq.description: The questions everyone has before handing over a project — answered plainly.
Faq.q1: How much does a website cost?
Faq.a1: It depends on size and features. A brochure site for a local shop is not priced like an e-shop with payments or a booking platform. You get a written, fixed-price quote with a clear scope before any work begins, with no hidden extras.
Faq.a2: A brochure site is usually ready within a few weeks of us having copy and photos. An e-shop or an application takes longer. The timeline is agreed together with the quote.
Faq.a3: Yes. We build online stores with Stripe payments, automated Greek myDATA invoicing and order management. We have also built an entire ordering platform, Orderoo, used by local shops with no commission to a third party.
Faq.q4: Will people find me on Google?
Faq.a4: Every site ships with technical SEO, structured data and Google Search Console connected, so it indexes correctly from day one. Competitive phrases also need ongoing content work — that is what the SEO & AEO service covers.
Faq.q5: Do you only work in Athens?
Faq.a5: We are based in Ilioupoli and meet easily across Attica, but we work with businesses all over Greece. Remote works well — several of our clients have never met us in person.
Faq.a6: We do not disappear. The code and the domain are yours, and you can continue on monthly maintenance for updates, backups and content changes. It is not compulsory — the site runs without us.
